out_of_scope.reason: Only the exclusion is out of scope: 'unless the creature must be Hostile or specifically a creature other than you'. No in-scope spell requires a Hostile creature or a creature other than the caster. The positive half is tested (Cure Wounds, Healing Word, Mage Armor, Magic Missile on the caster), and so is a negative (Light can't be pointed at the caster).

Every in-scope spell that targets another creature has a perceptible effect (damage, a condition, a visible ward, a spoken Command). No subset spell has a subtle effect whose target could fail to notice it.
The example subtle effect, reading thoughts (Detect Thoughts and similar), isn't in the implemented spell subset.

selected to receive the effects of a spell or another phenomenon
A Cone is an area of effect that extends in straight lines from a point of origin in a direction its creator chooses.
A Cube is an area of effect that extends in straight lines from a point of origin located anywhere on a face of the Cube.
A Cylinder is an area of effect that extends in straight lines from a point of origin located at the center of the circular top or bottom of the Cylinder.
An Emanation is an area of effect that extends in straight lines from a creature or an object in all directions.
A Line is an area of effect that extends from a point of origin in a straight path along its length and covers an area defined by its width.
A Sphere is an area of effect that extends in straight lines from a point of origin outward in all directions.
